== Notes ==
* Applies cripple before the effects of the attack skill, which enables skills like [[Reap Impurities]].
* Grenth's Grasp only transfers conditions after you've successfully hit the foe.
** If you're suffering from [[Weakness]] or [[Blindness]], they will still apply to your attack.
** The self-inflicted weakness from [[Wearying Spear]] is applied after the condition transfer. It won't be transferred until your next attack skill.
* Consider using with [[Volley]] for spammable mass cripple and condition transfer.
